module: Places TSStatic objects (.dae files) along the Road Architect roads, from the layers of the lateral profile. Two layer types are handled: type 4 (same mesh repeated over the whole length of the road) and type 5 (a single mesh unit). Called by roads.finalise; the objects are removed by tryRemove on unfinalise or when the road is deleted.
notes: The objects are created with decalType = 'None', canSave = true and added to the road's scene folder.
The name of each unique type 5 object is '<matDisplay> <road index>- single -<layer index>'.
The layer.mat field contains the shape file path (shapeName).

createStaticMeshes.desc: Iterates over the layers of the road's profile and creates the corresponding static objects (type 4: repetition along the road; type 5: single unit).

roadIdx.desc: Index of the road (used for naming).

tryRemove.desc: Removes from the scene all static meshes (repeated and unique) created for the road, and forgets their entries.

roadName.desc: Name of the road (the code comment talks about an index, but the key is the name).
